title: 14 Kazakh military personnel killed during naval exercise; five officers detained
summary_full: In a heartbreaking turn of events, 14 servicemen from Kazakhstan tragically perished during a naval exercise hindered by harsh weather conditions. In the aftermath, five defense officials were detained over alleged negligence regarding navigation protocols. Rescue teams bravely recovered three soldiers from the Caspian Sea. President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev has declared a national day of mourning to pay tribute to those who lost their lives.
